name: AI assistant prototype
summary: A working assistant over your own documents in four weeks, with an evaluation set that shows how well it answers.
audience: Small and medium firms with handbooks, archives or support answers nobody can find.
deliverable: A running prototype, its evaluation results and a plan for going to production.

name: Architecture review
summary: A two-day review of a web platform: what holds, what will break first and what to change.
audience: Teams about to grow a platform or replace part of it.
deliverable: A written report with prioritised recommendations and a follow-up call.

name: Evaluation setup
summary: An evaluation suite for an existing AI feature, so changes to prompts and models are measured, not guessed.
audience: Teams that already ship an AI feature.
deliverable: An evaluation suite in your repository, wired into continuous integration.
